description: Native-axis bounding-box boundary reported by the export.
limitations: No measured centroid fields are supplied. The accepted position proxy for the current 14 November 2026 scientist-directed analysis is the bounding-box midpoint: x=(XMin+XMax)/2, y=(YMin+YMax)/2. These reconstructed positions are not measured segmentation centroids; physical X/Y calibration remains unverified.
